text:
Anika: follow-up from rfc review: we need a clear runtime contract for per-request fidelity hints and how they interact with cache keys, fallbacks, and billing. quick brainstorm?
Raj: i'm worried about adding hint into cache key. cache fragmentation kills perf.
Felix: agreed. prefer: hint -> resolved_profile_id map looked up at ingress, but cache key uses resolved_profile_id only. hint itself is ephemeral.
Priya: ops: that mapping must be auditable and reversible. we need events when mapping changes.
Anika: mapping resolution flow idea: 1) request enters with header X-Fidelity-Hint: prefer_quality|balanced|prefer_cost 2) mapping service returns profile_id + stable_stamp 3) runtime pins profile_id for request lifetime and uses stable_stamp in cache key.
Raj: note: stable_stamp must be monotonic on profile semantic changes, not every metadata update. otherwise cache churn.
Felix: compatibility check: when profile_id is selected, runtime must verify model-compat signature (weights layout, kv-compat) and reject incompatible profiles with a clear fallback path.
Priya: fallback policy proposal: on incompat or quant-failure -> automatically step down to next-safe profile in precomputed chain; emit audit event and increment fallback counter.
Anika: chain examples will be per-model. e.g. for llama-2-7b: fp8v2 -> int8-compat -> int8-safe -> fp16. for code models, prefer conservative chain.
Raj: telemetry plan: expose profile_id, stable_stamp, hint, and effective_profile in logs. metrics per-profile: response_quality_score, token_loss_delta, and error_rate. use 10m rolling windows.
Felix: for synthetic checks add shadow-eval: copy 0.1% sampled requests to baseline fp32 and candidate profile; run offline diff and compute delta-summary (mean logit delta, KL, token-error-rate).
Priya: thresholds for alerts? ops wants numbers. propose: token-error-rate increase > 0.025 = warn, > 0.06 = critical. KL > 0.1 = warn, > 0.18 = critical.
Anika: also add hysteresis: require sustained crossing for 2 consecutive 10m windows to trigger auto-rollback. avoids flapping.
Raj: re-evaluate mapping frequency: don't re-resolve hint->profile more often than every 5m for a tenant unless the tenant is flagged as critical. prevents oscillation.
Felix: sampling determinism: use tenant hash mod 10000 for shadow and canary selection so we can reproduce.
Priya: ops CLI snippets we can include in runbook:
```
# view mapping for tenant
redwood quant-mgr mapping get --tenant=ozcorp --model=gptx-2
# force set mapping
redwood quant-mgr mapping set --tenant=ozcorp --model=gptx-2 --profile=int8-safe
# list recent fallbacks
redwood quant-mgr fallbacks list --since=24h
```
Anika: billing: tag requests with profile_billing_tag and surface in invoices. also allow tenant-level budget caps that trigger auto-downgrade when spent.
Priya: security/legal: hosted customers cannot permanently pin a profile_id via API. only Dedicated/Private can. hosted can request pin via support with approval. document in TOS.
Raj: test harness: add regression suite that runs 1000 sample prompts across profiles nightly; fail build if candidate profile increases token-error-rate by > 0.03 on stable seed set.
Felix: runtime implementation notes: when mapping service is down, fallback to last-known mapping for tenant if within TTL; otherwise pick conservative default profile to avoid quality regressions. log reason.
Anika: open question: should hints be additive or ordered? e.g. client sends prefer_quality + budget=low. probably make hint primary and budget a soft parameter in mapping.
Priya: ops: also want a one-click revert in console and a timeline view of mapping changes per-tenant.
Raj: one more: cache key stamping must include model_version + profile_stamp but not tenant_id to allow sharing cache across tenants when safe. mark shared caches accordingly.
Felix: agree. shared cache beneficial for small tenants. but need data isolation flag when tenant opts out.
Priya: incidents: OpsBot will auto-create ticket if fallback rate for a model > 1% for 5m. tag oncall and notify eng-ml.
OpsBot: noted. created ticket INC-2026-1099 for 'quant fallback surge' and subscribed @Priya @Anika.
Anika: action items:
- Anika: draft mapping API spec + cache key stamping doc (PR by Tue)
- Raj: profiling harness and sampling determinism implementation (PR by Wed)
- Felix: compatibility checks + fallback chain loader in runtime (WIP)
- Priya: ops runbook, thresholds, and CLI docs (doc by Fri)
Priya: I'll start the ops doc and share a draft in #eng-oncall. tagging @Felix @Raj for review.
Anika: thanks everyone. will post links here when PRs are open. closing thread.
